messages:
marta: Heads up — fresh checkout of ruby/sampleapp fails on `bundle install` during onboarding. It looks like the gemspec is indirectly pulling faraday 1.x and causing token refresh/retry breakage.

marta: Log snippet:
```
Fetching gem metadata... (19.6s)
Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem "faraday":
  In Gemfile:
    sampleapp depends on faraday (~> 2.0)

    other-gem depends on faraday (~> 1.9)
```

liam: ouch. can you paste the gemspec or the dependency tree? may be an accidental runtime dep in the gemspec.

marta: gist: https://gist.github.com/marta/short-repro (private) — short paste: `.add_dependency "http-helpers", "~> 1.0"` which transitively brings faraday ~> 1.9

alex: quick workaround: add an explicit top-level Gemfile entry `gem 'faraday', '~> 2.0'` then `bundle update --conservative faraday`. Forces resolution to 2.x so sampleapp boots.

sam: CI note: our Windows runners still use bundler 2.4 in some images which resolves differently. We should standardize README quickstart to require bundler >= 2.5 to avoid surprises.

devex-bot: FYI docs page: https://redwood-internal.devex/docs/ruby-onboarding#bundler-versions — recommends bundler >= 2.5 and shows how to pin transitive deps.

liam: created a small PR to relax the transitive gemspec and add an explicit faraday pin + README note: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/142 (WIP)

ci-bot: PR #142 triggered smoke CI — linux passed (job 558), windows job 562 failed (bundle resolution mismatch).

marta: I tested locally with the explicit pin and the sampleapp boots and auth token refresh works again. Will wait for the PR to stabilize.

alex: once PR is green, we should backport to the 0.9.x sampleapp tag and cut a tiny maintenance release. :thumbsup:

sam: filing a follow-up issue to normalize our CI base images (bundler/runtime) so future onboarding runs are consistent.

marta: thanks all — adding a 1-line repro to the quickstart and noting the temporary workaround. Much less onboarding friction now.
